headline: DPWH Brief Proposes ₱6.4-Billion Western Visayas Flood-Control Package for 2027
seoTitle: DPWH Brief: ₱6.4B Western Visayas Flood-Control Package for 2027 | FMB News
seoDescription: An approved FMB News brief reports a proposed ₱6.4-billion DPWH flood-control package for Western Visayas under the 2027 budget, covering river, drainage and coastal works.
deck: The approved newsroom brief says the regional proposal would fund river works, drainage upgrades and other flood-mitigation projects across Western Visayas under the 2027 spending plan.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: An approved FMB News morning brief reports that the Department of Public Works and Highways is proposing about ₱6.4 billion for flood-control, riverbank stabilization, dredging and drainage projects across Western Visayas under the proposed 2027 national budget.
The brief says Iloilo would receive the largest share and identifies planned works involving river channels, revetments, drainage systems and floodgates.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The proposed 2027 national budget includes ₱107.4 billion for DPWH flood-control spending nationwide, according to current reporting on the National Expenditure Program. That national allocation is separate from the regional ₱6.4-billion figure reported in the approved FMB News brief.

One source link supplied in the email for the regional figure resolves to an unrelated Daily Guardian page rather than the cited budget report. FMB News is therefore keeping the regional amount explicitly attributed to the approved newsroom brief instead of representing the broken source link as independent confirmation.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Western Visayas has repeatedly faced river overflow, urban drainage problems and agricultural flooding. Regional flood-control spending can reduce disruption only if projects are properly designed, transparently procured, maintained and matched to basin-level hydrology rather than treated as isolated structures.
The distinction between a proposed budget and an enacted appropriation also matters: Congress may still revise amounts before the 2027 General Appropriations Act is approved.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the House budget hearings, DPWH regional budget documents and final General Appropriations Act for the confirmed Western Visayas allocation and project-level breakdown. Also watch for engineering and procurement records that identify exact locations, costs and implementation schedules.
